capabilities: Insert a link to the nearest heading above the cursor
Run the insertion from the command palette
Assign a hotkey to the insertion command
disambiguation: Not for creating or editing headings; it only inserts a link pointing to the nearest existing heading above the cursor.
extras: README is minimal; a hotkey must be assigned manually by the user via Obsidian's hotkey settings if desired.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command for quickly inserting a link to a heading, so users must type the heading reference by hand.
summary: Command that inserts a wiki link to the nearest heading above the cursor, optionally bound to a hotkey.
